Hoi An Silk Lanterns Market [...] Every month on the 14th night of the lunar calendar, and most spectacularly during the Mid Autumn Festival (Tet Trung Thu), Hoi An Ancient Town switches off its modern electric streetlights. The entire UNESCO World Heritage town descends into an ethereal, golden sea of handmade silk lanterns, floating river candles, traditional folk games, and lion dance drumbeats. Here is everything you need to know to experience the magic without tourist traps. [...] 4:30 PM

### Pedestrian Zone Enforced and Craft Stalls Open

Motorbikes and scooters are barred from entering the Old Quarter. Riverside flower stalls and paper lantern crafters take their spots along Bach Dang Street and Nguyen Thai Hoc. This is the optimal time to browse before crowds pack the streets.
